title: Just ok
text: Just ok. It looks alittle cheap for the price and colors in pic where deceiving.  It's really only black and gold but I'm going to repaint some of it to my liking. Size is good and do like the shape. Glass globe was a little almost bubbly at the top so it is not perfectly clear.
